MKC Immigration Solutions Inc

Privacy Policy

How MKC Immigration Solutions Inc collects, uses and protects your personal information.

Last updated: October 2026

MKC Immigration Solutions Inc is an immigration consultancy in Mississauga, Ontario. This policy explains, in plain language, how we handle personal information. We follow Canada’s Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

What we collect

  • Contact form: the name, phone number, topic and message you choose to send.
  • Chat assistant: the website chat is automated and answers from the information on this site. It does not save or send what you type, so please don’t enter personal details there.
  • Consultations and files: if you become a client, we collect what is needed for your matter, such as identity and status documents, history and other details the application requires.

We only ask for what we reasonably need.

Why we use it

We use your information to reply to you, arrange and hold consultations, prepare and manage your application if you hire us, keep proper business records, and meet our legal and professional obligations. We don’t use it for unrelated purposes without asking you first.

Consent

We collect, use and share your information with your consent, except where the law allows or requires otherwise. Sending us a message or booking a consultation means you agree to us using your details to respond. For anything more sensitive, or any new purpose, we will ask you clearly.

Sharing

  • When you ask us to file an application on your behalf, we send the required information to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) or another government body involved in your matter.
  • We may use trusted service providers (for example, for secure storage or communication). They may use your information only to provide that service.
  • We may disclose information where the law requires it.
  • We never sell or rent your personal information.

How long we keep it

We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purpose it was collected, and for as long as legal or professional record-keeping rules require. After that, we securely destroy it or make it anonymous.

Safeguards

We use reasonable physical, organizational and technical measures to protect personal information from loss, theft and unauthorized access or use. Access is limited to people who need it to do their work. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, but we work to protect your information.

Your rights

  • Access: you can ask to see the personal information we have on file for you and learn how it has been used.
  • Correction: you can ask us to correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete.
  • Withdrawing consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time, subject to legal or contractual limits. We will explain if this affects our ability to help you.

We may need to confirm your identity before acting on a request.

Complaints

If you have a concern, please contact us first and we will try to resolve it. You may also file a complaint with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada ↗.

Contact us

For questions about this policy or your information, use our contact page, call +1 905-997-3200, or write to us at 154 Queen St S, Unit 212, Mississauga, ON L5M 2P4.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
